themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, such as data analysis, hypothesis generation, or information retrieval.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, often through natural language prompts.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles detailing AI applications for condensing large amounts of text, such as research papers, meeting transcripts, or user feedback, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI for design and research
themes.description: Topics related to AI tools and techniques that aid in the design process, including prototyping, ideation, and visual creation, as well as research platforms.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Studies and discussions on the user experience, capabilities, limitations, and societal impact of interacting with AI chatbots.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and analysis concerning how AI is affecting job roles, employment levels, and the skills required in the modern workforce.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Exploration of how AI is being integrated into the process of testing and evaluating the usability of products and services.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Discussions about specific AI-powered platforms and software designed to facilitate various aspects of user research and market analysis.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Articles highlighting platforms and frameworks that enable researchers to conduct studies, analyze data, and generate insights using AI.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Content related to the use of AI in creating, distributing, and analyzing surveys to gather user and market data.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
